paragraphs: If you own a rental property, you know anything can happen – tenants can stop paying rent, tenants can cause damage, neighbors can report criminal activity.

That is where Vaughn Law comes in. We have experience in disputes between landlords and tenants. Our team understands the real estate laws and regulations in Florida and around the Tampa Bay area. We can help you navigate your legal solutions.
